murals.name: 岁末守夜
murals.text: Scene: a winter night just before dawn on a snowy field below an immense white stone rampart. Behind, the rampart spans the picture, a thin line of white light along its top, watch-fires on its battlements; straight behind the centre a walled town sits astride a water gate. A row of waist-high boundary stones runs over the snow, each a white block bolted back to back with black obsidian. Centre-low, at the stone nearest the gate, a small folding table straddles the line, a pot and one lamp on it, a low ceiling of mist just above. Around it four small figures: a round halfling in grey-white robes, a barefoot young man with cropped straw-yellow hair and a coil of knotted rope, a young tiefling woman with two short straight horns and a misty-blue braid, a little boy at her side. Thin dark cracks run toward the table from every side like spokes of a wheel; right under it the snow has just split in a ring and begun to sink, the table tilting, the halfling half-risen and pushing the boy toward the boundary stone. Beyond the stones a night-wing man sits on a rock, watching. Stars overhead.
murals.light: Cold white light glowing along the top of the rampart and faint starlight on snow that casts almost no shadows, with one warm lamp on the table spreading its glow under the low mist; the darks are deep indigo.
murals.note: 画的是山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md 前夜三幕末尾（第2574到2579行）：归寂月末日岁末守夜，巴纳比的折桌支在水门底下那一块界碑旁边，两条腿在白石那一面、两条在黑曜石那一面，锅坐当中，卡雅把河上来的雾托过头顶，灯火在雾底下铺开，阿托吃饱了靠着姐姐，天快亮时脚底下响了一声。地从折桌底下开、桌子先往下一沉、巴纳比把阿托往界碑那边推了一把，照迷宫纪前传第一页寻人一幕第157行和委托寻人正面（第15行）。缝一道一道往水门那边去、像车轮的辐条，照前夜一幕第2545行。界碑那边石头上坐着看的夜翼是边官泽菲（第2575行）。界碑上刻的字没写。拿不准：挑的是地刚裂开、桌子往下沉的那一下，巴纳比连桌带锅滑下去那一下不画；嫌这一下险，可以退到响声以前四个人隔着界碑围着锅的那一刻，把裂成一圈往下沉那一句去掉就是。

notes: 地开那一夜挑的是地从折桌底下刚开、桌子往下沉、巴纳比推阿托的那一下（寻人第157行）；要更静一点，就退到前夜三幕天快亮、响声以前四个人围着锅的那一刻。
这一夜天上那一层光最淡，雪地上看不见影子（前夜第2578行），light 里写成雪地几乎没有影子；天上只写星。
墙上段城那一层白光、垛口的火、九十三号新地方的灯（前夜第2574行）都在，九十三号的灯这一稿为了字数没写，要添可以添在远处界碑那边。
